event.title: Kylian Mbappe Apologizes After Losing Chinese Sponsors Over Mao Comment
event.canonical_title: Kylian Mbappe Apologizes After Losing Chinese Sponsors Over Mao Comment
event.summary: Kylian Mbappe has issued an apology following backlash from Chinese fans over a comment he made about Mao Zedong, which he described as 'ill-judged.' His remarks led to the loss of several Chinese sponsors and resulted in the suspension of broadcasts of Real Madrid matches on Chinese state television.

timeline.title: Kylian Mbappe's Comments on Mao Zedong Spark Controversy in China
timeline.summary: Kylian Mbappe's remarks referring to Mao Zedong as a dictator have led to significant backlash in China, a key market for Real Madrid. In response to the controversy, Real Madrid has issued an apology to the Chinese people, acknowledging the sensitivity surrounding the topic of Mao in Chinese culture.

related_events.summary: Kylian Mbappé has faced significant backlash in China following a video in which he made comments about former Chinese leader Mao Zedong.
